entries.symptom: A skill placed in a grouping sub-folder (two levels below the skills folder) never appears
entries.cause: Skills are discovered exactly one folder deep

entries.symptom: The skill is listed with the description "---"
entries.cause: The opening --- is not line 1 (a blank line or byte-order mark before it), so the whole file became the body

entries.symptom: The skill is listed with its first body line as the description
entries.cause: The frontmatter YAML does not parse, so every field is dropped silently
entries.fix: One-line values only; quote values that contain ": " or " #"

entries.symptom: The skill is listed with its first body line and never triggers
entries.cause: The description field is missing or misspelled (unknown keys are ignored silently)
entries.fix: Write a description of at most 300 characters: verb first, trigger words, Not for

entries.symptom: A skill in a sub-folder's own .claude/skills is missing from the / menu
entries.cause: Nested skills load only after the agent reads or edits a file in that folder
entries.fix: Install skills at the repo root (.claude/skills/<name> or .agents/skills/<name>)

entries.symptom: A skill folder created mid-session does not appear
entries.cause: A new top-level skills folder is not watched until it is re-scanned
entries.fix: Run /reload-skills or start a new session

entries.symptom: The agent's Skill call is denied in headless runs (permission_denials: [Skill])
entries.cause: A skill with allowed-tools or hooks needs approval to be invoked by the model
entries.fix: No allowed-tools in skills; allow the scripts with a project Bash rule instead

entries.symptom: The agent says to type /name instead of using the skill
entries.cause: disable-model-invocation: true removes the description and blocks the Skill tool
entries.fix: Use it only on side-effecting run-* runbooks that stop and ask before the irreversible step

entries.symptom: A skill is missing from the listing, or /name does nothing
entries.cause: paths: hides it until a matching file is read; user-invocable: false hides it from the menu
entries.fix: Use only the keys the standard allows (name, description, metadata ...)

entries.symptom: Shell command failed for pattern ... and the skill never loads
entries.cause: A !`command` injection in SKILL.md exited non-zero or was not pre-approved
entries.fix: Run checks as normal shell calls from the instructions, not as injected commands

entries.symptom: A skill named like a bundled command replaced it, or a different skill loads than expected
entries.cause: Same-name skills shadow bundled commands, and a personal skill wins over a project skill of the same name
entries.fix: Never use bundled names (verify, run, debug, review, simplify, init, loop ...); keep names unique

entries.symptom: Some skills show only their name, no description
entries.cause: The skill listing exceeded its character budget and dropped the least-used descriptions
entries.fix: Keep descriptions short (aim for 250 characters); raise skillListingBudgetFraction in settings only if needed

entries.symptom: After a long session a skill's later sections are forgotten
entries.cause: After compaction only the first part of each invoked skill (about 5,000 tokens) is re-attached
entries.fix: Keep rules and the definition of done near the top; re-invoke the skill before verifying

entries.symptom: A skill script path works in one session and not another
entries.cause: Commands run in the session folder, not the skill folder
entries.fix: Call scripts through the skill folder: node ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/<x>.mjs

entries.symptom: A skill checker prints ERROR [bad-input] Unknown option '--root'
entries.cause: Every checker takes the repo root as its first positional argument, never --root
entries.fix: Run node <skill>/scripts/<checker>.mjs . [options]; the error's fix text prints the positional form

entries.symptom: A checker exits 2 with ERROR [bad-input] nothing to check
entries.cause: Exit 2 means bad input or nothing to check; it is never a pass (NOT APPLICABLE and SKIP lines with RESULT: PASS are the passing forms)
entries.fix: Rerun with the full command; if the target is created by a later step, name the check as not run yet in the report

entries.symptom: A repo checker reports findings inside skills/ or .agents/skills/
entries.cause: The checker walked the whole repo, including installed skills whose fixtures plant findings on purpose
entries.fix: A library bug: repo scans use walkRepo (it prunes every folder holding a SKILL.md); report it to skill-maintenance

entries.symptom: A script's output arrives as a file path plus a preview
entries.cause: Shell output over about 30,000 characters is not shown inline
entries.fix: Checkers print short problem lines and a RESULT line; long reports go to files

entries.symptom: Every shell call exits 1 with no output, even true (file reads and writes still work)
entries.cause: The agent session's shell tool broke after hours of long runs (exhausted processes or descriptors); nothing in the repo causes it
entries.fix: Stop at once and report what is done and what is left; the session needs a restart. Prevent it: stop your own simulators, emulators, Metro, Maestro drivers and log streams when done
